data.name: Jump Quest Online
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to my MMO! It's not about grinding dungeons or leveling your character. It is only about reaching the top. Many players will try the same, but some will not make it! Along the way you can also discover loot that makes you look cooler than your friend.

Features:

  • Jump (obviously) - Charge, release, launch... don't fall

  • Chat and Emotes - In order to satisfy the human need to communicate with strangers

  • Quests (obviously) - You can talk with NPCs and solve their miserable issues

Story:

I am the GAME MASTER of this world and I hate AI. That's why I imprisoned them into this world as NPCs. They think I will set them free if you beat the game. Let's see...

This game is for the following people:

  • Narcissists who play frustrating games for fun because their ego thrives when other people fail and quit. These ego driven players want to reach the top just so they can prove themself better than anyone else, while deep down...

  • Social players who like playing games by not actually playing but they do some other stupid things. They like to talk and stuff. They tend to be secretly introverted.

  • Sadists who just log on and sit around a difficult jump just to watch people fail and fall all the way down. They find simple peace and pleasure in that act.

  • Rage Quitters who buy the game, fail, quit, refund and cry about it.

  • Collectors who want to brag about having unlocked way cooler visuals than every other player. And rightfully so, because they achieved these visuals through pure in-game sweat. If someone asks to buy visuals for real money, they get banned!

  • True explorers who know that there is no beauty to be found without wandering far enough. The journey is the goal, alongside the people you fall and suffer with along the way.

  • Lonely people who want to play a single-player game but can't because they get anxious.

  • Kiddos that want to unlock all the dance emotes so they can be annoying.

----------

Trailer music made by Euphlka

data.short_description: Once again, you need to reach the top. Yes, you will fall, you will suffer, and you will have to try again! But at least you can do so together with other people around you that you don't know or care about! Welcome to the first and only Jumping MMO you will ever need.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 / AMD RX 6600 (8GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
